notes.note: Ambiguity: read 'TypeDefIdentifier' as an identifier referring to a type definition; test uses an anytype alternative selected by a user type name inside the ExtendedFieldReference of a value redirect (f_any.MyInt). The anytype extension attribute is only for Titan.
Ambiguity: chose reading 1 (parenthesized integer only for enumerated values with a value list, cf. clause 6.2.4); tests the 'only if' direction with e_blue(0) for a single assigned value.

NLChar tested via BinSpace ('\' NLChar) in a bitstring literal, using LF only; other newline characters (VT, FF, CR) not covered. Titan rejects the backslash-newline in binary strings, which is a Titan limitation (BinSpace ::= " " | "\" NLChar).
ExtendedAlphaNum tested via FreeText of a display attribute with characters from the allowed ranges; the excluded ranges (e.g. 127..160, 173) are not tested.
Tested via an attribute qualifier selecting an anytype alternative by type name (f_any.MyInt); the module extension attribute is only for Titan.
Ambiguity: chose the restrictive reading; value list notation for a union type is rejected (consistent with clause 6.2.5).

Ambiguity: chose the permissive reading (positive test for array, record, record of and set of constants); set types are not tested as excluded because clause 6.2.2 allows value list notation for sets.

Uses a bare compound expression as the SingleExpression of a select statement. Titan accepts it by inferring the type from the case templates; per the BNF static semantics this is not allowed, so the test is kept.
Requirement text is truncated; only the << / >> part is tested (integer left operand of >>), the rotate operator rule is not covered.
Ambiguity: chose reading 1 (rule applies when a UnaryOp is present); test applies unary - to a bitstring.
Ambiguity (float operands of rem/mod): test uses a charstring operand of mod, which is rejected under both readings.
